fixture_purpose: Demonstrates that provider_session_resurrection is universally blocked at Phase 0/pre-4, so the orphan-reap-before-resurrection path cannot be triggered. Phase 4 per-adapter enablement requires superseding this fixture with runtime evidence.

evidence.mechanism: mode == 'provider_session_resurrection' returns -32010 provider_session_resurrection_unsupported before any resurrection dispatch, before any orphan ACP subprocess interaction, and before any provider_session_attach path.
evidence.hold_predicate_prevented: No resurrection request can proceed to orphan-reap or attach-receipt stages at Phase 0/pre-4. The hold condition (resurrection accepted without reaped orphan ACP evidence) cannot be triggered.
evidence.deferred_evidence: Phase 4 enablement requires: orphan ACP subprocess detection, durable reap/quarantine evidence, and continuation_orphan_acp_subprocesses_reaped_total metric. This fixture must be superseded with runtime evidence when Phase 4 is enabled for any adapter.
